headline: Samco Securities suggests shifting portfolio focus toward Indian stocks
hook: Equities look historically cheap relative to gold
summary: Samco Securities reports that the Sensex-to-Gold ratio has fallen to 6.43, significantly below its long-term median of 9.8, signaling potential undervaluation for Indian equities. The brokerage recommends increasing equity exposure for Samvat 2083 while maintaining existing gold holdings as a hedge. Despite the valuation appeal, the firm warns of risks from high crude oil prices, currency depreciation, and global volatility. They suggest diversifying into US-listed energy and healthcare ETFs to mitigate domestic risks.
why_it_matters: Historical valuation gaps suggest potential for higher equity returns this year.

headline: Samco Wealth recommends 10 stocks for Samvat 2083 Muhurat Trading
summary: Samco Wealth has released its top 10 stock picks for Samvat 2083, highlighting potential upsides of up to 109 percent following a volatile year in the markets. The recommended basket spans multiple sectors and includes companies such as Azad Engineering, Adani Power, HFCL, Tech Mahindra, and BSE. Other notable picks in the list are L&T Technology Services, Tips Music, TVS Motor, Sansera Engineering, and MCX. Retail investors looking to rebalance their portfolios for the new Hindu calendar year can evaluate these brokerage recommendations against their own risk appetite.
why_it_matters: Provides retail investors with brokerage stock ideas for Samvat 2083.

headline: LT Technology reports 2% revenue growth in September quarter
hook: Modest revenue growth for LT Technology
summary: LT Technology reported standalone net sales of Rs 2,587.20 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. This represents a 2.01% increase compared to the same period last year. The company's performance reflects steady but slow top-line expansion. Retail investors should note this growth rate as a benchmark for the company's current operational momentum.
why_it_matters: Signals slow growth trajectory for the engineering services firm.

headline: L&T Technology Services and Nokia partner for engineering support in India
hook: Engineering partnership to boost local tech capabilities
summary: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) has entered into a strategic partnership with Nokia to provide engineering services and support within India. The collaboration aims to leverage LTTS's engineering expertise to enhance Nokia's local operations and infrastructure development. This deal strengthens the presence of both companies in the domestic engineering and telecommunications ecosystem. For retail investors, this signals a potential expansion in LTTS's service portfolio and revenue streams from the telecom sector.
why_it_matters: Potential revenue growth for LTTS through expanded telecom engineering contracts.
winners_losers: LTTS gains / Engineering competitors face increased competition

headline: L&T Technology Services secures a five-year R&D support contract from Nokia in India
hook: Multi-year telecom R&D deal for L&T
summary: L&T Technology Services has won a five-year contract from Nokia to support its research and development operations in India. The engagement involves engineering and technology collaboration across Nokia's wireless networks and hardware divisions. For Indian retail investors, this deal highlights steady enterprise tech spending and order book additions for mid-tier IT services firms. It demonstrates ongoing foreign client reliance on Indian engineering talent for core telecom development.
why_it_matters: Long-term revenue visibility strengthens LTTS order book.
winners_losers: LTTS gains / rival IT firms neutral

headline: L&T Technology Services secures five-year contract with Nokia
hook: New five-year deal boosts L&T Tech
summary: L&T Technology Services has entered into a five-year partnership with Nokia to collaborate on telecommunications engineering. The companies will utilize an integrated operating model, combining L&T's engineering expertise with Nokia's global R&D teams. This deal follows a 4% jump in L&T Tech's share price following the announcement.
why_it_matters: Long-term revenue visibility strengthens the company's growth outlook.
winners_losers: LTTS gains / Competitors face increased competition

headline: LTTS shares climb 3% on new Nokia engineering deal
hook: Five-year R&D partnership secured with Nokia
summary: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) has signed a five-year agreement to provide engineering and research and development services to Nokia. The deal expands the company's footprint in the telecommunications sector. Following the announcement, LTTS shares rose by more than 3% during trading. This contract win signals continued demand for outsourced engineering services among global technology firms.
why_it_matters: Long-term contract wins boost revenue visibility for IT engineering firms.
winners_losers: LTTS gains / Competitors face increased competition

headline: L&T Technology Services shares rise over 3% following a five-year deal with Nokia
hook: New Nokia deal lifts engineering shares
summary: L&T Technology Services has secured a five-year partnership with Nokia to support research and engineering activities in India. The collaboration centers on 5G network development, artificial intelligence infrastructure, and next-generation computing. Following the announcement, the company's shares rallied by over 3 percent. For Indian retail investors, this multi-year deal highlights strong order book additions in the technology services segment.
why_it_matters: Multi-year Nokia deal strengthens LTTS order book.

headline: L&T Technology Services signs multi-year deal with Nokia
summary: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) has entered a five-year agreement to provide engineering research and development services to Nokia. The partnership focuses on supporting Nokia's mobile network business, specifically in the areas of radio and transport hardware. This deal expands LTTS's footprint in the telecommunications sector by leveraging its expertise in 5G and connectivity technologies. The collaboration is expected to enhance Nokia's operational efficiency in product development.
why_it_matters: Strengthens LTTS revenue visibility in the competitive telecom engineering space.
winners_losers: LTTS gains / Competitors face increased pressure

headline: L&T Technology Services collaborates with Nokia for engineering solutions
hook: New engineering partnership signed with Nokia
summary: L&T Technology Services has announced a strategic engineering collaboration with Nokia on October 26, 2026. The partnership focuses on combining engineering capabilities to drive joint solutions. Such tie-ups typically help mid-to-large IT services firms expand their telecom and enterprise tech order books. Indian retail investors tracking engineering R&D services will note this as a potential revenue driver for LTTS.

headline: Nine stocks set to trade ex-dividend this week
hook: Upcoming payouts for nine listed companies
summary: Nine listed companies have scheduled their dividend record dates for the current week following their September quarter results. The roster includes Hexaware Technologies, L&T Technology Services, Cyient, Nippon Life India AMC, CRISIL, Shriram Finance, Chennai Petro, RailTel, and Steel Strips Wheels. Shareholders owning these stocks before the record date will be eligible for the announced payouts. Retail investors holding these specific names can expect the dividend amounts credited according to the companies' timelines.
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders receive cash payouts this week.

headline: Cyient, LT Tech, Hexaware, and others set dividend record dates this week
hook: Upcoming dividend payouts across five IT firms
summary: Five IT stocks have set dividend record dates between October 26 and 30, offering payouts to eligible shareholders. L&T Technology Services leads with ₹20 per share, followed by Cyient at ₹12, Hexaware at ₹9.50, and Sagility at ₹0.15. Meanwhile, the Nifty IT index gained 1.17% over five sessions despite overall market weakness. Indian retail investors holding these stocks before the record date will receive the announced cash distributions.
whats_next: Dividend record dates from October 26 to 30
why_it_matters: Cash payouts credited directly to eligible shareholders' accounts.
winners_losers: IT dividend stock holders gain / none hurt
